sentences.en: I can't afford to buy a laptop for my son.
sentences.zh: 我负担不起给儿子买笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: "Why did you buy a new laptop?" "I couldn't resist!"
sentences.zh: "你为什么要买新笔记本电脑？" "我忍不住了！"

sentences.en: She sat in front of her laptop in her pajamas.
sentences.zh: 她穿着睡衣坐在笔记本电脑前。

senses.zh: 膝上型轻便电脑，笔记本电脑
